_comment: Reactions to world events (world events menu): when a country declares war on another, or annexes it, and the player is on neither side, the entry carries these options for 'days' days. Effects use the event effect dictionary (Politics.apply_effects): 'self' is applied to the reacting country, 'target' to the victim, 'actor' to the aggressor; the words 'actor' and 'target' in effect values become those countries. 'require': equipment in stock. 'news': the entry written when a country chooses the option. 'ai': how AI great powers answer the player's own aggression (democracies condemn a non-democratic aggressor). Numbers: a condemnation is a diplomatic note (10 influence) that rallies the public (+2% war support); 500 rifles arm five infantry battalions (100 each); staying out keeps the country calm (+1% stability); refusing to recognise an annexation is a legal claim worth a casus belli (25 influence, the price of a quick justification); recognising it eases world tension a little.
